title.value: Submit a CoverageEligibilityRequest resource for assessment

description.value: This operation is used to submit a CoverageEligibilityRequest for assessment either as a single CoverageEligibilityRequest resource instance or as a Bundle containing the CoverageEligibilityRequest and other referenced resources, or Bundle containing a batch of CoverageEligibilityRequest resources, either as single CoverageEligibilityRequest resources or Bundle resources, for processing. The only input parameter is the single CoverageEligibilityRequest or Bundle resource and the only output is a single CoverageEligibilityResponse, Bundle of CoverageEligibilityResponses or an OperationOutcome resource.

documentation.value: A CoverageEligibilityRequest resource or Bundle of CoverageEligibilityRequests, either as individual CoverageEligibilityRequest resources or as Bundles each containing a single CoverageEligibilityRequest plus referenced resources.

A CoverageEligibilityResponse resource or Bundle of CoverageEligibilityResponses, either as individual CoverageEligibilityResponse resources or as Bundles each containing a single CoverageEligibilityResponse plus referenced resources.
